name: Longsword
description: A versatile martial weapon favored by many warriors for its balance between damage and flexibility.

name: Shortsword
description: A light, finesse martial weapon ideal for quick strikes and dual wielding.

name: Greataxe
description: A massive two-handed martial weapon that deals devastating damage with each swing.

name: Longbow
description: A tall bow made of a single piece of wood, effective at long range.

name: Dagger
description: A simple, versatile blade useful both in melee and as a thrown weapon.

name: Leather Armor
description: The breastpiece and shoulder protectors of this armor are made of leather that has been stiffened by being boiled in oil.

name: Chain Mail
description: Made of interlocking metal rings, chain mail includes a layer of quilted fabric worn underneath to prevent chafing and to cushion the impact of blows.

name: Plate Armor
description: Plate consists of shaped, interlocking metal plates to cover the entire body. It includes gauntlets, heavy leather boots, a visored helmet, and thick layers of padding underneath the armor.

name: Shield
description: A shield is made from wood or metal and is carried in one hand. Wielding a shield increases your Armor Class by 2.

name: Backpack
description: A backpack can hold one cubic foot or 30 pounds of gear. You can also strap items, such as a bedroll or a coil of rope, to the outside of a backpack.

name: Rope, Hempen (50 feet)
description: Rope has 2 hit points and can be burst with a DC 17 Strength check. It can be used for climbing, binding creatures, and various other purposes.

name: Torch
description: A torch burns for 1 hour, providing bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. If you make a melee attack with a burning torch, it deals 1 fire damage.

name: Rations (1 day)
description: Rations consist of dry foods suitable for extended travel, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts.

name: Potion of Healing
description: A character who drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 hit points. Drinking or administering a potion takes an action.

name: Thieves' Tools
description: This set of tools includes a small file, a set of lock picks, a small mirror mounted on a metal handle, a set of narrow-bladed scissors, and a pair of pliers. Proficiency lets you add your proficiency bonus to checks to disarm traps or open locks.

name: Herbalism Kit
description: This kit contains a variety of instruments such as clippers, mortar and pestle, and pouches and vials used by herbalists to create remedies and potions. Proficiency lets you add your proficiency bonus to checks to identify or apply herbs.

name: Smith's Tools
description: These special tools include the items needed to pursue a craft or trade. Smith's tools include hammers, tongs, charcoal, rags, and a whetstone. Proficiency lets you add your proficiency bonus to objects you craft or repair with these tools.
